HALLUCINATIONS:
- In the "Transaction Description" section, the memo states the facility has "a consortium of 12 lenders". The source document's signature pages show 13 distinct lenders: Citizens Bank, N.A., Atlantic Union Bank, Bank of America, N.A., Capital One, National Association, Fifth Third Bank, National Association, JP Morgan Chase Bank, N.A., Manufacturers and Traders Trust Company, MUFG Bank, Ltd., Raymond James Bank, TD Bank, N.A., Truist Bank, Webster Bank, N.A., and Wells Fargo Bank, N.A.

ANSWER: YES
MISSING_TERMS:
- The names of the individual Lenders in the syndicate are not listed in the memo. The source document's signature pages list all 13 lenders by name (e.g., Atlantic Union Bank, Bank of America, N.A., Capital One, National Association, etc.).
- The names of the specific Guarantor entities are not listed in the memo. The source document's signature pages list all 19 guarantors by name (e.g., LGP OPERATIONS LLC, ERICKSON OIL PRODUCTS, INC., CAPL RETAIL LLC, etc.).
